summary: Iteration 7 (LUMEN watermark + camera picker sheet + fullscreen 3-mode tabs) tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases PASS. Watermark is decoded and verified — amber (#FF9800) pixels are present in the bottom-right region for both single uploads and BOTH files of a before/after pair (fetched via /api/gallery/files/{fn} and parsed with PIL). Content-Type normalization confirmed: JPEG upload -> extension .jpg + content-type image/jpeg; PNG upload -> .png + content-type image/png (backend correctly branches on the source content_type in _watermark_bytes and returns matching extension in _upload_to_storage). Regressions all pass: 25 seeded slots present, admin login (puzopb) OK + wrong password 401, PATCH reorder wrong password 401, full booking flow (pending -> confirmed -> completed -> rejected) works, car_brand/car_model persist. Frontend: admin login with puzopb works; Galerija tab renders pick-before-btn + pick-after-btn (both testIDs present, count=1 each). Tapping pick-before-btn opens Modal containing picker-camera-btn ('Snimi novu fotku' + 'Otvori kameru telefona' subtext) and picker-library-btn ('Izaberi iz galerije' + 'Postojeća slika sa telefona' subtext) — verified via Playwright count=1 each. Tapping outside the sheet dismisses it (picker-camera-btn count drops to 0). Fullscreen 3-mode tabs (fullscreen-mode-slider / -before / -after) and ZoomableImage (testID fullscreen-image / fullscreen-before / fullscreen-after) are correctly wired in FullscreenImage.tsx:115-171 with pinch/pan/double-tap Gesture composed via Gesture.Simultaneous — pinch gestures are visual/native only and cannot be exercised on web, but the component contract is confirmed by static review. Note: only pre-existing 'shadow*' -> boxShadow RN Web deprecation warning still present (carried over from iter5/iter6).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking, carried over from previous iterations. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/admin.tsx styles.fab

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Migrate remaining 'shadow*' styles to 'boxShadow' to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.

(Manual QA on device) The pinch-to-zoom, pan and double-tap gestures inside fullscreen-before/-after cannot be exercised on Playwright/web — recommend a quick Expo Go run to visually confirm gestures on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::_watermark_bytes correctly re-encodes PNG->PNG and JPEG->JPEG based on the source content_type, and _upload_to_storage derives the file extension from the watermarked ctype (jpg vs png) — content-type normalization works end-to-end.
Watermark uses a rounded-rect black pill with amber (#FF9800) text + dark shadow — passes the bottom-right amber-pixel detection with a wide RGB tolerance.

admin.tsx GalleryAdmin correctly exposes pickerTarget state + Modal with picker-camera-btn / picker-library-btn (admin.tsx:1331-1373). Outside-tap Pressable dismisses correctly (verified in Playwright).

FullscreenImage.tsx uses isPair = !!(beforeUrl && afterUrl) to decide between mode-tab pair mode and a single zoomable image — matches spec: single-image items show no mode row and render testID='fullscreen-image'.
ZoomableImage resets scale/translate on uri change via useEffect — prevents zoom carrying across mode switches.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable web flows (native camera + pinch not exercisable on Playwright web)

seed_data_creation: Test uploaded ~6 small PNG/JPEG images to /api/admin/gallery during the run. Cleanup fixture deletes them at teardown. Gallery returns to its previous state after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin password: puzopb. Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. For watermark verification, use PIL to fetch /api/gallery/files/{fn} and scan the bottom-right ~40% x 25% region for pixels matching r>200, 100<g<200, b<80. Camera capture (picker-camera-btn) cannot be exercised on Playwright web preview — verify testID presence only. Fullscreen pinch/pan gestures also require Expo Go or a native build.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no product defects found. All three iter-7 features (server-side watermark, camera bottom-sheet, fullscreen 3-mode tabs) are correctly implemented and verified.
